name: laptop-frame
title: Laptop frame
description: A laptop drawn in CSS around a screenshot or live UI: lid, bezel, hinge and base, with a lid that opens from 0 to 1 so a scroll position can lift it.
docs: Pass src and alt for a screenshot, or children for live UI; the screen keeps 16 / 10 and clips to its corners. Everything on the device is a share of its own width (container units), so it scales with width: set width in px or any CSS length, and size live UI in cqw (text-[1.5cqw]). tone is the body finish, dark (graphite) or light (silver). open (0 to 1) turns the lid on its hinge; feed it a scroll value to lift it on scroll. The device is decoration: the alt of the picture, or label for live UI, is what is read.
